description.value: Sunrise Pita Bread is a family-run Burnaby bakery founded in 2005 that produces stone-ground whole-wheat pita bread and pita chips using all-natural ingredients. Products are stocked at major supermarkets across the Lower Mainland and Fraser Valley, but cyclists can also pick up fresh bags directly at the bakery outlet. It is a compact specialty stop for high-quality fresh bread to fuel a ride.

enrichment_extras.reasoning: The website confirms the business is a real, operating pita bread bakery with a retail outlet at 102, 3650 Bonneville Place, Burnaby, BC — not North Vancouver as OSM's community field suggests. Phone number 604-421-7482 matches both OSM and the website. No cyclist-specific amenities (bike parking, water refill, washrooms, etc.) are mentioned anywhere on the site; the sitemap lists meats and produce that appear to be placeholder/template content inconsistent with the actual products page, which shows only pita bread varieties.
concerns: OSM community field says 'North Vancouver' but the business address is clearly Burnaby, BC (3650 Bonneville Place, Burnaby) — OSM geolocation or community tag may be incorrect.
Website is significantly outdated (copyright 2016, last blog posts January 2017) though the About page references '19th year of business' suggesting ongoing operations as of ~2024.

Sitemap contains apparent placeholder/template product listings (meats, vegetables, organic produce) that do not appear on the actual Products page and are inconsistent with a pita bakery — these should be disregarded as stale demo content.
enrichment_extras.recommended_status_reason: Real, operating bakery outlet where the public can purchase fresh pita bread directly; a practical food resupply stop for touring cyclists passing through Burnaby.

wow_evidence: family-run Burnaby bakery founded in 2005... products are stocked at major supermarkets across the Lower Mainland and Fraser Valley
